hero.eyebrow: Free research tools · Reviewed knowledge · No sign-up to start
hero.title: Every research task. One verified toolkit.
hero.summary: Start with a transparent tool, then continue into reviewed research guidance, primary sources and institutional support when the decision requires it.

library.summary: Reviewed guidance for research integrity and research design, with four additional evidence domains developing under the same governance standard.

tools.label: Check a journal
tools.description: Review identity, registry, indexing-snapshot and clone-alert evidence without an invented legitimacy score.

tools.label: Find candidate journals
tools.description: Build a literature-neighbour shortlist of journal-type, ISSN-bearing OpenAlex sources for further investigation.

tools.label: Look up a recorded APC
tools.description: Inspect source-labelled APC and open-access fields recorded in OpenAlex without treating missing data as advice.

tools.label: Check references and DOIs
tools.description: Compare reference details with Crossref records and surface recorded corrections or retractions for manual review.

tools.label: Triage an APC invoice
tools.description: Turn a questionable publication invoice into a factual discrepancy register without issuing a fraud verdict.

tools.label: Audit research readiness
tools.description: Convert eight self-reported evidence-control states into a gap register and next-control plan.

tools.label: Plan an SEM sample
tools.description: Compare three disclosed planning approximations and their limitations before undertaking model-specific power analysis.

tools.label: Check reliability and validity
tools.description: Calculate alpha, composite reliability and AVE with explicit data checks and non-universal reference markers.

tools.label: Map NAAC evidence
tools.description: Inventory present, partial and missing records across the legacy seven-criteria structure without generating a score.

tools.label: Plan a PhD timeline
tools.description: Create a printable milestone plan aligned to the UGC PhD Regulations 2022 timeframes and honest sequencing.

tools.label: Track research grants
tools.description: Review ICSSR, ANRF and allied funding calls with every listed opportunity linked to its official source.
